comments.value: I mean sounds like a fun idea. Some of those numbers appear quite low for the amount of time people play this game, but the averages are something the dev team can look into. You’re effectively asking for some sort of achievement system and your details on what rewards could be given seem like a great start. You have my vote.

details:

Anti-cheat might have to be added for this too work might be awhile.

Can't Buy points other than Vrchat plus sub
-Daily Login point 75
